newsitem.title: USA: Ceridian acquires fuel management company.
newsitem.headline: Ceridian acquires fuel management company.

text.p: Ceridian Corp said Thursday it acquired Archco Inc, a fuel management services company with about $2 million in revenues in 1996.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
Archco, based in Edina, Minnesota, provides fuel consulting, designs and maintains fuel networks, negotiates volume discounts and gives performance analyses. It has 24 employees.
Archco will be part of Comdata, Ceridian's information services fro the transportation market. The company said it will expand Archco's services.
